fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-microdata) carry headline/articleBody-style fields scraped from schema.org microdata + HTML; latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-microdata, S2-rss, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description/dek -- meta[itemprop=description] on article records, or the RSS item description on latest-mode records.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div[itemprop=articleBody] > p paragraphs.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name, from the .author-name element (itemprop=author is an empty placeholder on this site).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of RSS <category> values for the item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
